value.rationale: The theorem exactly answers the equal-weight lower-Khintchine endpoint under pairwise independence and also identifies the opposite first-moment extreme. The normalized L1/L2 ratio ranges from o(1) to 1-o(1), a structural contrast with mutual independence.
